digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict signing and provider tracking
propositions: Signed gate verdicts must record not only model string but also provider identity, endpoint host, tier classification, and effective capabilities as an additive optional provider_provenance field

Provenance record assembly must occur in capabilities.py as a leaf module taking only primitives (provider, model, base_url, caps) and reuse the single per-run capabilities resolution to prevent divergence from actual execution

All three sidecars (plan-review, completion, code-review) must persist provider_provenance alongside existing model field, and finalize_verdict must thread the already-assembled record from runner outputs into gate verdicts
Endpoint host extraction must use urlparse(base_url).hostname not .netloc to exclude credentials, and persisted payload must never contain userinfo or api_key substrings
Legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must load and verify without breakage, and backward-incompatible payload changes must not occur
Tier field must distinguish first_class (direct provider with key) from best_effort (custom base_url) based on presence of config base_url
